content: The ESC 2014 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events at the European Society of Cardiology Congress 2014, held at the Hotel Arts Barcelona, Spain. Below are the detailed descriptions of the scheduled interviews and their respective topics: 1. Friday, August 29, 2014: Open time slots are available throughout the day. 2. Saturday, August 30, 2014: At 10:00 AM, Dr. Barbara Casadei will discuss the Perioperative statin treatment in cardiac surgery for the prevention of atrial fibrillation and perioperative myocardial damage: the STICS Trial. The embargo on this information lifts on Tuesday, September 2, 2014, at 11:20 AM. At 10:30 AM, Dr. Michelle O’Donoghue will present the Stabilization of plaques using Darapladib Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction 52 (SOLID-TIMI 52) trial: Primary Results. The embargo lifts on Sunday, August 31, 2014, at 4:30 PM. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Dan Atar will discuss the Effect of intravenous TRO40303 as an adjunct to primary percutaneous coronary intervention for acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction: Results of the MITOCARE study. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 5:42 PM. 3. Sunday, August 31, 2014: At 9:00 AM, Dr. Gilles Montalescot will present on In-ambulance versus in-cath lab administration of ticagrelor in STEMI patients transferred for primary PCI: the randomized, double-blind ATLANTIC study. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 4:48 PM. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Atul Verma will discuss Optimal method and outcomes of catheter ablation of persistent atrial fibrillation: Results of the Prospective, Randomized STAR AF 2 Trial. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 12:12 PM. At 11:30 AM, Dr. Milton Packer will present the Results of the Prospective comparison of ARNI with ACEI to Determine Impact on Global Mortality and morbidity in Heart Failure trial (PARADIGM-HF). The embargo lifts on Sunday, August 31, 2014, at 8:30 AM. At 1:00 PM, Dr. Inder Anand will discuss Autonomic regulation therapy for the improvement of left ventricular function and heart failure symptoms: The ANTHEM-HF Study. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 11:18 AM. 4. Monday, September 1, 2014: At 11:30 AM, Dr. Renato Lopes will provide a Wrap-Up in Portuguese. At 12:00 PM, Dr. Basil Lewis will provide a Wrap-Up in Hebrew. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Sergio Leonardi and Dr. Leonardo De Luca will provide a Wrap-Up in Italian. At 3:30 PM, Dr. Hisao Ogawa will discuss The differences of the effects on lipid-lowering actions and glucose metabolisms between rosuvastatin and atorvastatin in Japanese diabetic patients with hyperlipidemia. The embargo lifts on Sunday, August 31, 2014, at 5:42 PM. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Philippe Meurin will present Colchicine for Post-operative Pericardial Effusion: The post-operative pericardial effusion (POPE-2) Study. The embargo lifts on Sunday, August 31, 2014, at 9:42 PM. 5. Tuesday, September 2, 2014: At 9:30 AM, Dr. Thomas Pilgrim will discuss the Randomized comparison of a novel, ultrathin strut biodegradable polymer sirolimus-eluting stent with a durable polymer everolimus-eluting stent for percutaneous coronary revascularization. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 11:00 AM. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Riccardo Cappato will present The X-VERT Trial: A comparison of oral rivaroxaban once daily with dose-adjusted Vitamin K Antagonists in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation undergoing elective cardioversion. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, September 2, 2014, at 11:18 AM. At 11:15 AM, Dr. Massimo Imazio will discuss Colchicine for Prevention of the Post-pericardiotomy Syndrome and Post-operative Atrial Fibrillation (COPPS-2 trial). The embargo lifts on Sunday, August 31, 2014, at 10:00 AM. At 12:30 PM, Dr. Anthony Gershlick will present Complete versus Lesion-only Primary PCI Trial (CvLPRIT): Treat the infarct-related artery only or all lesions. The embargo lifts on Monday, September 1, 2014, at 4:30 PM. At 1:00 PM, Dr. Paul Armstrong will provide a Wrap-Up from a Canadian perspective. At 1:30 PM, Dr. Bongani Mayosi will discuss the IMPI Steroid Study: A Trial of Adjunctive Prednisolone in Tuberculous Pericarditis. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, September 2, 2014, at 12:12 PM. At 2:00 PM, Dr. A. Verheugt will provide an ESC 2014 Wrap-Up in Dutch. At 2:30 PM, Dr. Lorenz Räber will present Effect of high-intensity statin therapy on atherosclerosis in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction: Results of the prospective, longitudinal intravascular ultrasound follow-up study. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, September 2, 2014, at 11:54 AM. At 3:30 PM, Dr. Stine Darkner and Dr. Jesper Swendsen will discuss Recurrence of arrhythmia following short-term oral amiodarone after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, September 2, 2014, at 11:36 AM. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Philip Aylward will provide a Wrap-Up from a Pacific Rim perspective. 6. Wednesday, September 3, 2014: Open time slots are available throughout the day.
